summary: Phase 10E retry qualified the latest eligible iOS simulator runtime and XCTest healthcheck. Broad Apple scenario execution did not start because the canonical smoke planner still selected only HA cases and exposed no Apple adapter executable scenario set.

apple_adapter: Boot the configured simulator and wait for bootstatus before simulator install, launch, screenshot and log collection primitives.
Terminate the primitive launch before running XCTest so UI tests start from their configured launch arguments.
apple_client: Clear stale crash prompt state during --uitesting launches while preserving production crash detection.
Narrow the primary-tab healthcheck to primary tab availability; deeper More navigation remains separate UI coverage.
verification_gate: Treat policy-deferred distribution signing, cross-device simulators and physical-device targets as non-blocking SKIPPED checks for current platform verification.

crash_log_analysis.result: No simulator CrashReporter crash file was found for DJConnect. The app persistent log showed normal launch/demo messages. Stale UserDefaults crash prompt state, not a fresh crash stack, blocked the earlier UI healthcheck.

classification.notes: The Apple runtime is qualified, but Phase 10E cannot execute broad Apple scenario coverage until canonical scenarios can be planned as Apple adapter cases.
